hooks.command: d=$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" | tr '\\' '/'); while [ ! -f "$d/.claude/hooks/library.py" ]; do p=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$p" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d="$p"; done; for PY in python3 python py; do "$PY" -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$PY" "$d/.claude/hooks/library.py" pre; done; exit 0

d=$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" | tr '\\' '/'); while [ ! -f "$d/.claude/hooks/library.py" ]; do p=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$p" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d="$p"; done; for PY in python3 python py; do "$PY" -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$PY" "$d/.claude/hooks/library.py" post; done; exit 0
